2607.25294.title: CLBench-V: Evaluating Multimodal Context Learning from Grounding to Knowledge Acquisition
2607.25294.paper_summary: Real-world tasks often require models to learn from task-specific context rather than relying only on pre-trained knowledge. While recent work has highlighted this capability as context learning, existing evaluations mainly focus on textual contexts. In many practical settings, however, the context to be learned from is multimodal: scientific findings are conveyed through figures and tables, financial indicators are scattered across converted reports, and spatial decisions depend on maps, scenes, or web pages. We introduce CLBench-V, a benchmark for multimodal context learning that addresses the difficulty of localizing where context use breaks down by organizing tasks around three dimensions: context grounding, new information application, and new knowledge learning. CLBench-V combines converted public benchmarks with newly constructed datasets spanning domains such as science, finance, long-document understanding, spatial reasoning, and web-based visual question answering. To reduce the cost of constructing domain-specific context-learning tasks, we further use automated construction and filtering procedures for our newly built datasets. Across 3,443 instances and six recent multimodal models, the best overall score is only 0.2847, indicating that multimodal context learning remains far from saturated. Moreover, InternVL3.5-30B-A3B performs best on context grounding and new knowledge learning, while Qwen3.5-Plus performs best on new information application. We further analyze judge reliability, context length, image count, and representative failure cases. Code is available at https://github.com/IamLihua/CLBench-V.
2607.25294.paper_summary_zh: 現實世界的任務通常要求模型從特定任務的上下文中學習，而不僅僅依賴於預訓練的知識。雖然最近的研究突出了這種能力作為上下文學習，但現有的評估主要集中在文本上下文上。然而，在許多實際情境中，需學習的上下文是多模態的：科學發現通過圖表和表格傳達，金融指標分散在轉換的報告中，而空間決策依賴於地圖、場景或網頁。我們介紹了 CLBench-V，一個針對多模態上下文學習的基準，通過圍繞三個維度組織任務來解決上下文使用失效的定位難題：上下文基礎、新信息應用和新知識學習。CLBench-V 結合了轉換的公共基準和新構建的數據集，涵蓋科學、金融、長文檔理解、空間推理和基於網絡的視覺問答等領域。為了降低構建特定領域上下文學習任務的成本，我們進一步使用自動構建和過濾程序來處理我們新建的數據集。在 3,443 個實例和六個最近的多模態模型中，最佳整體得分僅為 0.2847，這表明多模態上下文學習仍然遠未飽和。此外，InternVL3.5-30B-A3B 在上下文基礎和新知識學習方面表現最佳，而 Qwen3.5-Plus 在新信息應用方面表現最佳。我們還進一步分析了評審可靠性、上下文長度、圖像數量和代表性失敗案例。代碼可在 https://github.com/IamLihua/CLBench-V 獲得。
